exercises.q: I pulled up to the house.
exercises.why: **подъехал** — подъе́хать (perfective): to drive up (to); (colloquial) to drop in, to pay a short visit; (colloquial) to get (round), to start a pick up line, to get on the right side (of). Wiktionary: под- + е́хать.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to run up, to come running up to
to support, to back up, to second
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: подбежа́ть — to run up, to come running up to; поддержа́ть — to support, to back up, to second; откры́ть — to open; отда́ть — to give back, to return.
**подберу** — подобра́ть (perfective): to pick up; to sort out, to select, to glean. Wiktionary: подо- + брать.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.
